2015–16 season on Bowe Bergdahl's departure from his Afghanistan post.

How Serial Season 2 connects

  • Character: Bowe Bergdahl — Bowe Bergdahl is the soldier Season 2 investigates.
  • Topic: Serial — Season 2 is Serial's Bowe Bergdahl season.
  • Work: Serial Season 1 — Season 1 came before the Bergdahl season.
  • Work: Serial Season 3 — Season 2 came before the Cleveland courthouse season.
  • Artist: Sarah Koenig — Koenig hosted Season 2 on Bergdahl after Baltimore.

What is Serial Season 2?

Season 2 leaves Baltimore for Bowe Bergdahl: a U.S. soldier who walked off a base in Afghanistan, a court-martial, and Koenig's attempt to apply the Season 1 method to a national-security story.

Key threads lead to Bowe Bergdahl, Serial, Serial Season 1, Serial Season 3 and Sarah Koenig.
